extraction_notes: Woodward is a tier-2 subsystem supplier (propulsion controls, actuation, fuel/combustion, motion control). 10-K names defense platforms (F-35, F-15, Blackhawk, Apache, smart defense weapons, guided weapons, missiles) and one explicit defense-related M&A (Safran Electronics & Defense electromechanical actuation acquisition). No specific PE numbers or quantified program-level revenue disclosures appear in slice. Aerospace segment includes both commercial and defense; top-5 customer concentration ~36% with no >10% single customer.
